answer: Each account sinks one serialized ferrous counterweight balanced by a walnut float in the ocean-fed basin; serial and mass go on-ledger as the vote's root. Each ocean tide shifts moorings, so a weighmaster re-weighs each ferrous piece against its walnut float before any vote; a mismatch voids the account. Spawning N puppets means casting and sinking N counterweights with per-piece serial and weigh fees — no bulk discount, since every mass is measured alone and duplicate serials are rejected. An honest account sinks one set and pays once.
